title: Anova Preheat Delay by Container
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anova:session
| stats avg(preheat_min) as avg_preheat_min, max(preheat_min) as max_preheat_min by vessel
| where avg_preheat_min>25 OR max_preheat_min>40
| sort - avg_preheat_min
description: Uses Anova preheat telemetry telemetry to monitor how quickly different bath setups reach target temperature in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for containers that consistently slow down prep, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Anova preheat telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vessel table of average preheat duration.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how quickly different bath setups reach target temperature so you can spot containers that consistently slow down prep before it becomes annoying.
